## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2021-04-01: TRA executed at the Up-C Reorganization between Stronghold and Q Power LLC; filed later as Exhibit 10.3 to the July 2021 S-1
- 2021-10-22: IPO closed

#### Beneficiary addition

- 2022-11-09: William Spence added as TRA Holder via Joinder (Section 7.6(a)(i)) following a 1,000,000-Unit transfer from Q Power LLC

#### Bitfarms merger and termination

- 2024-08-21: Stronghold signed an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Bitfarms Ltd. and a concurrent TRA Waiver and Termination Agreement under which Q Power and Spence waived the Section 4.2 Early Termination Payment in full for $0
- 2025-03-14: Bitfarms acquisition closed; TRA terminated at the Effective Time

## Explanation

Stronghold Digital Mining executed this TRA on April 1, 2021 at its Up-C Reorganization, agreeing to pay 85% of net cash tax savings from Section 754 basis step-ups generated by future Redemptions of Common Units held by Q Power LLC (the founders' vehicle). William Spence joined as an additional TRA Holder in late 2022 after a Unit transfer from Q Power, without changing the contract's economic terms. When Bitfarms Ltd. agreed to acquire Stronghold in August 2024, the TRA Holders signed a Waiver and Termination Agreement concurrent with the merger agreement, accepting $0 (a full waiver of the change-of-control Early Termination Payment) in lieu of the Section 4.2 formula; the only consideration they received was the all-stock merger consideration in their capacity as Stronghold stockholders. The TRA was extinguished when the Bitfarms acquisition closed on March 14, 2025. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
